Introducing the Sakura Slub Selvedge, a heavyweight 16.5oz Japanese Selvedge Denim woven on vintage shuttle looms in Okayama, Japan. This denim is woven with big slub yarns that alternate between thick and thin sections, not only does this create an incredible denim texture but also impacting dye penetration during the rope dyeing process. As a result, sections of the yarn fade at different rates, unveiling a stunning spectrum of indigo hues as the denim ages.
